figures.original_caption_text: Fig. 1. Overview of W HOLE B ODY WAM. We curate UniMotion-4K with over 400M whole-body motion frames from 1.19M human and humanoid motion sequences, totaling more than 4K hours, to pretrain a predictive Motion Expert. The learned motion prior is then integrated with Video and Action Experts and transferred to real-world humanoid whole-body control.
